_comment: Every player-visible UI string outside NPC dialogue (docs/GODOT.md §6). {vars} come from GameState.vars().
help: WASD move · Shift jog · Q/E or ←/→ orbit (or drag) · right-click / hold to walk there · Space talk · 1–9 choose · Esc close
help_debug: debug: F2 opening · F3 counter · F4 vault · F6 lobby · F7 manager · F8 name desk · F1 legend
prompt_elevator_main: [Space] Elevator — back to the Main wing
elevator_arc_deferred: ARC floor — coming soon. The Arc wing is under construction; the Main wing keeps serving.
escort_arrived: Here we are. Bob has your wire.
desk_link_lost: Lost the branch for a moment — reconnecting…
desk_link_back: Back in touch with the branch. Board re-read from the vault.
priority_copy: Skip the cooling period — hand scan required.
name_claim_hint: Your name will point to your AccountBlox on ENSv2 Sepolia.
name_claim_bad_label: Choose one label only — Petra adds .branchzero.eth.
passbook_anon: No account yet — see Ines at Account Opening.
passbook_no_account: Account not opened yet — Ines will open one.
passbook_delegated: Tellers stamp your slips (session signer, no pop-ups)
passbook_mock: MockChain — nothing on this screen is on a chain
board_no_account: no account at this branch yet
slip_hint: Up to {limit} {symbol} goes over the counter. More than that goes through the vault ({timelock} cooling).
slip_bad_address: That is not an address the counter can pay (0x + 40 hex).
slip_bad_name: Write a full customer name, like alice.branchzero.eth.
slip_bad_amount: Write the amount as a number, e.g. 12.5
